headline: Katsafados: New state and insurers roadmap for natural disasters – Support within 5 days
summary: A new framework for cooperation between the state and the insurance market on natural disaster losses is expected at an October 21 session of the Private Insurance Against Natural Disasters Observatory. Support is due within five days.
why: Natural disaster insurance programs set how losses are shared between the state and private insurers, affecting insurance sector exposure and public finances.
